description: This file defines an abstract class DaoAuthenticationScheme within the org.openmrs.api.context package. It serves as a base class for authentication schemes that utilize OpenMRS's ContextDAO for authentication-related operations.

classes.name: DaoAuthenticationScheme
classes.description: An abstract class providing a method to access ContextDAO, intended for authentication schemes leveraging OpenMRS context.

methods.name: getContextDAO
methods.description: Returns the ContextDAO instance associated with the current context.
